subtitle: Lesson 6 · SOQL Fundamentals

code:
SELECT Id, Name, Status__c,
       Budget__c, Start_Date__c
FROM Project__c
WHERE Status__c = 'Active'
  AND Budget__c > 50000
ORDER BY Start_Date__c DESC
caption: Custom object and fields end in __c. Id and Name do not.

code:
SELECT Id, Name, Industry,
       Region__c, Customer_Tier__c
FROM Account
WHERE Customer_Tier__c = 'Gold'

-- Account: standard, no suffix
-- Region__c: custom, suffix
caption: The suffix marks whatever is custom.

code:
SELECT Name, Budget__c,
       Account__c,
       Account__r.Name
FROM Project__c
WHERE Account__r.Industry = 'Technology'

-- __c holds the Id
-- __r walks the relationship
caption: Standard lookups work the same way: Account.Name.
